response.sql:
WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / CAST(sm.geomdeltamm AS REAL)) as site_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as site_mesh_count
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
filtered_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.zoneregistry,
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.site_ratio,
    sr.site_mesh_count,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  insurstat,
  AVG(site_ratio) as avg_ratio_of_kept_sites,
  SUM(site_mesh_count) as total_mesh_records,
  AVG(site_ratio - status_avg_ratio) as avg_excess_over_status
FROM filtered_sites
GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: "that site's number of mesh records" refers to the count of mesh records used in the site's average ratio calculation—that is, records with non-null facetresmm, non-null geomdeltamm, and non-zero geomdeltamm. This interpretation aligns with "ignoring missing ratios."

alternatives.interpretation: "that site's number of mesh records" could mean the total count of all mesh records for the site (including those without valid facetresmm or geomdeltamm values), rather than only those used in the ratio.

WITH all_site_mesh_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    COUNT(*) as total_mesh_count
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / CAST(sm.geomdeltamm AS REAL)) as site_ratio
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
site_data AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.zoneregistry,
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.site_ratio,
    asmc.total_mesh_count
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN all_site_mesh_counts asmc ON sr.zoneregistry = asmc.zoneregistry AND sr.insurstat = asmc.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_data
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
filtered_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.zoneregistry,
    sd.insurstat,
    sd.site_ratio,
    sd.total_mesh_count,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_data sd
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sd.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sd.site_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  insurstat,
  AVG(site_ratio) as avg_ratio_of_kept_sites,
  SUM(total_mesh_count) as total_mesh_records,
  AVG(site_ratio - status_avg_ratio) as avg_excess_over_status
FROM filtered_sites
GROUP BY insurstat
